meta.title: Dev Toolbox
meta.description: Right-sidebar development toolbox: workspace file tree, code editor with save (⌘S), word wrap, go-to-line (⌘G), full-text search (⇧⌘F with regex/whole-word/context), find-in-file (⌘F), LSP definition/references jumps (Go/TS/Python), image & Markdown/SVG previews, git stage/commit/changes diffs over the whole file (changed-line marks, folded deletion bars), skills manager, API tester (history/favorites/multipart), grouped sidebar launcher.
